Set sail into a lifestyle that celebrates the harmony between wind, water, and the spirit of adventure.

Elevate your yachting experience with the expertise and elegance encapsulated in every detail of Denison yachts.

programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.title: The Komodo dragons of south Rinca, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.longSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area is well known to be one of the best place to see wild Komodo dragons. The Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), also known as the Komodo monitor, is a member of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang. It is the largest extant species of lizard, growing to a maximum length of 3 metres, and weighing up to approximately 70 kilograms. As a result of their size, Komodo dragons are apex predators, and dominate the ecosystems in which they live. Komodo dragons hunt and ambush prey including invertebrates, birds, and mammals. It has been claimed that they have a venomous bite; there are two glands in the lower jaw that secrete several toxic proteins. The biological significance of these proteins is disputed, but the glands have been shown to secrete an anticoagulant. Komodo dragons' group behavior in hunting is exceptional in the reptile world. The diet of Komodo dragons mainly consists of Javan rusa (Rusa timorensis), though they also eat considerable amounts of carrion. Komodo dragons also occasionally attack humans.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.title: Lawa Darat island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.longSynopsis: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park. Also known as the “island close to the land” has a barren, desert savannah that changes color from green to yellow depending on the season. The island features easy hiking trails and two viewpoints to suit both spectacular sunrise and sunsets. Lawa Darat island is well protected from strong winds and waves, making the island the perfect spot for various activities to be carried out in safety. Some even refer to the island as the Komodo’s fjord, as attributed to its geological position. Besides, Lawa Darat island’s proximity to the ocean crossroads enables visitors to experience unexpected marine surprises such as encountering the humpback or the blue whale emerging majestically from the sea. The main attraction of Lawa Darat island is the scenic view that awaits visitors as they trek and reach the peak. This sole reason is what drives most Komodo National Park visitors to land on this island. Although beautiful all day long, the best recommended time to trek to the peak is sunset, when the breathtaking panoramic view calls for an Instagram selfie. The vantage point makes it perfect for capturing the beautiful beaches or the rolling hills catching rays of light. Trekking to the peak of the island might be considered as quite challenging for some, in particular, the beginners, but it is incredibly doable and worthwhile. The view is better and more beautiful as you trek higher where the reef becomes clearer while the mountainside begins to glow. Be ready for the remarkable panorama that awaits you at the top where the Komodo National Park lies in the opposite.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.title: Horseshoe Bay, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.longSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area of Rinca island south is undeveloped compared to Komodo island. It is dry and hot, the dense forest will give way to savannah grass. The area is well known to have many Komodo dragons as well as wild pigs, buffalos, deers, monkeys and many bird species.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean.
programme.title: Dive Site Manta Alley, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean.
programme.longSynopsis: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean. Manta Alley consists of a series of small rocky islands a few hundred meters away from the main island. There are several spots around these rocks where mantas can be found almost all year round. The site starts in a shallow reef close to the shore, where you can expect a strong to mild drift dive. You should keep your eyes wide open just as you enter the water, as mantas can be often found right in the shallows. Manta Rays are coming to this area for mating and cleaning purposes, where small wrasse and butterfly fish clean the mantas of parasites. The cleaning station is around 20 meters, where the rocks meet a white sandy bottom, perfect spot to watch mantas gliding into the rocks. Though mantas are the main attraction of this site, Manta Alley it is also full of marine life including reef sharks, schools of trevallies and large wrasses. The corals are very beautiful and diverse as well, making this spot a spectacular background for marine life photography.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Maravilla, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. The cenote is a sinkhole in the shape of a bell, where the entrance is a hole in the middle of the top. The thick sulfur cloud offers views that look from another planet. Getting close to this cloud is necessary to observe the gorgeous living stalactites, the biothems often called “Hell’s bells.” Those mysterious rock formations are alive and grow underwater thanks to extraordinary endemic bacteria. This type of speleothems, called “elephant feet,” has been found in only 4 cenotes, all in the Puerto Morelos area and are subject to ongoing scientific research.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain.
programme.title: Dive Site Boo West, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain.
programme.longSynopsis: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain. There are rows of sea fans, large and small. The palette of the coral reefs ranges from yellow to pink to purple. A school of silver slides can show off as they moved rapidly as a pack.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Kecil, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.longSynopsis: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. The best time to dive this site is when the current is running! This is a real rollercoaster of a ride and will often be referred to as the 'Superman drift'. This gorgeous coral reef with a stunning overhang has a fast moving current - nothing scary just a great drift along. No need to kick! Towards the end of the dive site you drift towards and more sheltered area and the current eases off. Here you can relax (catch your breath!), and admire the stunning hard corals and thousands on anthias. This is also a great spot for seeing hawksbill turtles. The strong currents of this dive site attract large fish including giant trevally, barracuda, tuna, sharks and the odd ray too! The overhangs provide a fascinating topography and if the current allows they are great to explore and hunt for nurse sharks, bamboo sharks and other bizarre creatures.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (northern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.title: Batu Bolong north, Komodo, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (northern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.longSynopsis: You are about to go on a fascinating journey through the amazing underwater world of Batu Bolong. As you watch this remarkable documentary, you will discover the wonderful beauty and diversity of life below the waves. Located within Indonesia's Komodo National Park, Batu Bolong's exposed rock pinnacle reveals a hidden paradise full of marine wonders. Despite challenges like changing currents and depths, you will learn how expert divers navigate the currents and explore different depths, from shallow coral gardens to tall walls. You will see the vibrant underwater dance of reef fish, including colorful groupers, moray eels, and majestic emperor fish. You will encounter the mysterious white tip reef shark, marvel at its unique anatomy, and understand its interesting behaviors. As the documentary reveals the top predator, the giant trevally, you will be captivated by its striking features and hunting skills. You will delve into the complex relationships within the ecosystem, from cleaner fish caring for their companions to the vital role of table corals in sheltering marine life. Immerse yourself in this kaleidoscope of colors, shapes, and behaviors, and let the enchanting beauty of Batu Bolong's underwater world leave you longing for more, ready to return to this aquatic oasis time and again.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Angelita, Tulum, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum. Angelita is a magical cenote that is often described as mysterious and a bit spooky. At first, the cenote appears to be unassuming, just a small pond in the middle of a very thick jungle. However, the deepest parts of the cenote go down to 204 ft (66 m). Its most amazing feature is a 4.5 ft (1.5 m) thick hydrogen sulfide cloud that starts at 83 ft (27 m). This cloud is made up of gases that have leaked out of decomposing trees and leaves that fall from the jungle into the cenote. This gas accumulates where the fresh and the salt water meet (the halocline). This creates a false floor at the bottom, which can be traversed to reach a dark, otherworldly chamber that is full of jungle detritus. The base of this mountain of detritus starts below but reaches above the cloud. Rising again from below the cloud, the peak of the mountain of detritus takes on a new face, as if one is ascending a cloud-topped mountain. On the way out of the cenote, there is a small cave loop, and at the surface, one can get an appreciation for all of the trees that provide this cenote with its hydrogen sulfide cloud.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Tormentos, Cozumel, Mexico (Part 1)
programme.shortSynopsis: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel. Tormentos Reef is located off the coast of Cozumel and houses a rich variety of marine life. Here you can find purple and orange coral structures, tunnels hiding nurse sharks and sea turtles, and huge rays nestled in the sand.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Paradise Reef, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel. Paradise Reef is the first reef when entering the Marine Park. The current runs from south to north normally. You will start across from the entrance to the Caleta and drift north. There are 2-3 coral ridges that parallel the shoreline. You can see schools of Grunts, Snappers, and Sergeant Majors, many Queen Angelfish. There are nice coral heads ranging from 3-6m tall that jut out from a sandy bottom. You can find anemones, and an assortment of nice sponges clinging to the coral heads. Just about every kind of fish from the area can be found here. Some of the bigger animals include barracuda and grouper. Keep a close eye for the small denizens such as Spotted Drum, Smooth Trunkfish, Spotted Moray Eels, and Spiny Lobster.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island.
programme.title: Lawalaut Island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island. Gili Lawa Laut is understandably a magnet for visitors on land and sea. The island is in the Lesser Sunda Islands and sits to the north of Komodo Island and the other small islet of Gili Lawa Daret and as such is protected as part of the Komodo National Park. Geologically the islets are volcanic like much of the region and they have beautiful hills popular with hikers who come for the stunning views and secluded beaches. The island is uninhabited but has numerous trails for walking up the hills to see the surrounding area. The wildlife above water is slightly less of a draw than the sea life on this island as there is less vegetation than in other areas. The hills are grassy though, and the landscape is very beautiful and a popular photography spot for visitors to the national park.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua.
programme.title: Arborek Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua.
programme.longSynopsis: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua. It is easily walkable on foot, taking roughly thirty minutes to walk the entire coastline. The island is known for its very hospitable tourism village and exceptional handicrafts with a thriving souvenir community. Be ready to be greeted with open arms by everyone, with many children who are eager to be photographed. This authentic island welcomes guests with pride, the islanders are happy to introduce all to the Papuan culture and unique traditional foods. It is a perfect paradise to learn a bit of the Asai culture, which is still kept alive in this isolated place. Arborek island, traditionally a mooring spot for boatmen, is surrounded by splendid sago palms, nourished by fish and it is sparsely populated by a tiny population of around 200 residents, spread in around 40 families. The water is crystal clear, with white fine sand and many coconut trees and bushes, providing a quite comforting and refreshing atmosphere. At the wooden pier you will find some gazebos, ideal for relaxing.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Yucab, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel. There is a huge concentration of marine life which covers this reef. There are sponges everywhere and of every color. The sand scoured overhangs offer refuge for lobsters, banded coral shrimps and the arrow crab. There are also large numbers of squirrelfish, angel and butterflyfish always swimming in pairs. This is a great site for photographers.

programme.desc: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel.

programme.shortSynopsis: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel. Also called Cedral Wall it is one of the most beautiful dive sites in Cozumel. It can be done as a wall dive or closer to shore over the reef. The part of the reef that is not a wall, consists of a mile of sloping hills covered in sponges and coral. The reef bottoms out at about 18 meters (60 feet). As for the current, it's generally moderate to strong. As you drift you'll get to see eagle rays, lobsters, hawksbill turtles, green morays, big pufferfish, toadfish, and even sharks.

programme.longSynopsis: San Clemente dive site is located in the south west of Cozumel. San Clemente Reef is a beginner diver's dream, with shallow depth between 10 meters and 15 meters and little current. As it is located between the Yucab Reef and the Tormentos Reef, San Clemente shares plenty of similarities with these two dive sites. Divers can encounter here spotted moray eels, butterflyfish swimming in pairs, groupers, snappers, grunts, scorpionfish, angelfish, seahorses hidden in the grass, damselfish, cowfish, eagle rays, filefish, barracudas. This dive spot has a mostly sandy bottom with coral outcrops and patches.

It is a pinnacle reef out in the open ocean with the reef starting at around 8 meters from the surface and descends down to a depth of approximately 30 meters. Almost everything can be seen from mantas, sharks and tuna to massive schools of jacks and barracuda. Along the slopes and onto the reef top are a variety of fans, sponges and soft and hard corals.

programme.desc: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Zapote, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. Cenote Zapote is named after the Sapote trees growing nearby. It is located on the “Ruta de los Cenotes” the old road from Puerto Morelos to Valladolid. Zapote has quite a deep drop from the land surface to the water surface of 6m/20ft but its access is easy via stairs. The walls will rise above you like a fortress and once you start your descent they become narrower until a depth of 20m/66ft before starting to open back up again. Once you reach a depth of 30m/100ft you will be above the talus cone in a bell shaped chamber with a narrow skylight in the top through which you just descended. Halocline and a thin misty layer of Hydrogen Sulfide floating on top of it, as well as some of the most amazing and incredible formations commonly described as bells, elephant feet, shower heads or trumpets will truly take your breath away with their strange beauty and impressive size.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai.
programme.title: Dive Site Saporkren at Night, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai.
programme.longSynopsis: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai. This site is typically dived at night, however day diving is good too. Saporkren is your typical sandy bottom muck dive site, which is a little grubby since its just off of the village jetty. Making your way down a gentle slope (with little or no current) past a few coral bommies, the best bit of Saporkren is generally around 12-20 metres. We found full-size seahorses, cute bobtail squid, flying flatworms, clownfish anemones, colemani shrimp plus many unusual crabs species such as the boxer, xeno and porcelain.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island.
programme.title: Padar island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island. Padar is the third largest island in the Komodo National Park. It is located in the south central of the park, between Komodo and Rinca Island. In the past, Padar was one of the island in Komodo where there were dragons live. Along with the illegal hunting activities by human being, they are slowly disappeared and almost unable to see them anymore. The cause is simply because of the lack of foods, like deer and wild boar. Their extinction can be because they just died alone without any food to eat or prolonged hunger or they can be migrated to nearest island, Rinca. The island now remains empty with no dragons. However, other wild animals such as wild boars are still around daily. Today, Padar has become one of the most popular place to visit in Indonesia. It offers super magnificent view from the top of the island with pink sandy beach on the west side and white sandy beach on the east side. Formation of towering hill, just like Jurassic park. Although the island has no dragons existed, the island is one of the best charming spot of trekking. Those who love photographic, this is perhaps the best place for spectacular photos.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site C56 Shipwreck, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos. The C-56 shipwreck served in World War II and it was sold to the Mexican Marine in 1966. The time pass by and later on 28th Oct 2000 was purposefully sunk, as a new attraction for divers coming to the Riviera Maya. Laying perfectly upright, with the keel on the sand at 90ft, the 184ft long Mexican Gun Boat was quickly inhabited by various marine life. The deck, at 64ft, is teeming with life and it's common to see a large shoal of Big Eye Travellies hunting there. As we travel around the wreck we commonly see large Wrasse, Groupers, Morays and, looking up, flights of Eagle Rays. Soft corals have colonized the wreck and now offer a home to many Arrow crabs and Fire worms amongst other small crustaceans and invertebrates.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Sumidero Canyon is located just north of the city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez.
programme.title: Sumidero Canyon, Tuxtla Gutiérrez , Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Sumidero Canyon is located just north of the city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez.
programme.longSynopsis: Sumidero Canyon is located just north of the city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez. Sumidero Canyon (Spanish: Cañón del Sumidero) is a deep natural canyon which creation began around the same time as the Grand Canyon in the U.S. by a crack in the area's crust and subsequent erosion by the Grijalva River, which still runs through it. Sumidero Canyon has vertical walls which reach as high as 1,000 metres, with the river turning up to 90 degrees during the 13 kilometre length of the narrow passage.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Wayag Island is located on the far northwestern tip of Raja Ampat.
programme.title: Wayag Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Wayag Island is located on the far northwestern tip of Raja Ampat.
programme.longSynopsis: Wayag Island is located on the far northwestern tip of Raja Ampat. The island is known for its beautiful atolls and amazing underwater life covering a total area of 155,000 hectares, about 383,013.3 acres. Here, you find pristine beaches with unique Karst islands that look like mushrooms sprouting out from the sea. Along these beaches, tourists can see fairy tale panorama, more captivating than Leonardo DiCaprio’s getaway in “The Beach”. The crystal clear waters around Wayag Island appear like unreal windows to various types of flora and fauna that live underwater.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (southern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.title: Dive Site Batu Bolong South, Komodo National Park, Indonesia Trailer
programme.shortSynopsis: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (southern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.longSynopsis: Embark on an amazing journey to explore the wonders of Batu Bolong south, a remote and enchanting diving location in Komodo National Park. Dive into crystal-clear waters with excellent visibility to encounter a vibrant array of marine life and stunning underwater landscapes. However, navigating the challenges of strong currents and varying depths requires careful preparation and diving experience. From the captivating giant trevally to the intricate social structures of anthias, you'll observe fascinating behaviors and adaptations of the underwater world's inhabitants. The documentary also sheds light on the unique coral reefs, their crucial symbiotic relationships, and the serious threats they face. This highlights the urgent need for conservation efforts to protect these vital underwater ecosystems often referred to as the "rainforests of the sea." Ultimately, this episode provides a captivating and educational glimpse into the incredible marine life and underscores the importance of preserving these precious underwater environments.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

The Tatawa Islands, be it Tatawa Besar or Tatawa Kecil, contain extraordinary sea life and some of the best snorkeling spots in Komodo National Park.

programme.desc: Cenote Dos Ojos is located 15 kilometers north of Tulum.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Dos Ojos, Tulum, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Dos Ojos is located 15 kilometers north of Tulum.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Dos Ojos is located 15 kilometers north of Tulum. Dos Ojos (Two Eyes) refers to two neighboring cenotes that are connected by a large cavern that also connects to a subterranean river. The original explorations of this water system, one of the largest in the world, started in the Dos Ojos cenotes. The total length of the combined system was measured at 310.95 kilometers (193.22 mi). This cenote dive site consists of two independent circuits: The first dive starts at the Barbie Line, a 415 meters line with wide spaces and large light galleries. The second dive circuit is called the Bat Cave, a very different experience. The Bat Cave is an adjacent cenote, next to Dos Ojos, and represents a much more preserved environment, mainly due the fact that the roof of the cenote hasn’t collapsed yet and all of the formations around it are in very good shape.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.longSynopsis: In this episode, we will explore Tatawa Besar dive site, located in the Komodo National Park in Indonesia and learn about its incredible marine life. Discover the unique behaviors of species like the Titan Triggerfish and Leopard Flounder. Explore the vibrant coral ecosystems, understand coral reproduction methods, and witness the vital role of sponges in the marine environment. Delve into the colorful world of fish species such as the Crescent-tail Bigeye and neon fusiliers. You'll also have the chance to observe the stunning shallow coral garden or seek out fascinating macro critters like the ribbon eel.

programme.desc: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Besar, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.longSynopsis: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar dive site is a sheltered bay with coral seamounts and amazing coral reefs, located in the North-West side of the island. The reef is 4-6 meters deep with healthy corals and sand patches around. It has a massive coral garden and lacks strong currents, but it does not mean it lacks cool sights and marine life, just the opposite! This feature makes Siaba Besar a suitable dive site for any kind of level, being the best place for those who have never dived and want to try this amazing experience in Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar is heaven for snorkelers, given its easy conditions with shallow coral reefs, very little current and abundant marine life. A superlative snorkeling among sea turtles it is guaranteed, which gives the nickname to this site: Turtle City

The topography of the site differs greatly from other ones, it is one of the most fascinating and unique in the park. It has almost anything a diver can hope to see, both big and small, an enjoyable dive is guaranteed.

programme.desc: Exploration and marine life of Manta Point dive site, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.title: Dive Site Manta Point, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Exploration and marine life of Manta Point dive site, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.longSynopsis: In this episode, you will explore Manta Point, located in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia, and learn about its remarkable marine inhabitants. Manta Point, situated on Nusa Penida's southwest coast, is renowned for its resident Manta ray colony, making it a must-visit dive site. Divers of all levels are drawn to its diverse range of underwater experiences, including reef exploration, photography, training, and fish identification. Notable species found here include the day octopus and the tawny nurse shark, both captivating creatures. Manta rays, particularly the Manta alfredi species, gracefully glide through the water with their distinctive pectoral fins and are often seen at cleaning stations, where cleaner fish help them rid parasites. However, these majestic creatures face threats from overfishing and human impacts. Manta Point offers an extraordinary underwater adventure, showcasing the beauty and diversity of marine life in this region.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.title: The Komodo dragons of south Rinca, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.longSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area is well known to be one of the best place to see wild Komodo dragons. The Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), also known as the Komodo monitor, is a member of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang. It is the largest extant species of lizard, growing to a maximum length of 3 metres, and weighing up to approximately 70 kilograms. As a result of their size, Komodo dragons are apex predators, and dominate the ecosystems in which they live. Komodo dragons hunt and ambush prey including invertebrates, birds, and mammals. It has been claimed that they have a venomous bite; there are two glands in the lower jaw that secrete several toxic proteins. The biological significance of these proteins is disputed, but the glands have been shown to secrete an anticoagulant. Komodo dragons' group behavior in hunting is exceptional in the reptile world. The diet of Komodo dragons mainly consists of Javan rusa (Rusa timorensis), though they also eat considerable amounts of carrion. Komodo dragons also occasionally attack humans.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.title: Lawa Darat island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.longSynopsis: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park. Also known as the “island close to the land” has a barren, desert savannah that changes color from green to yellow depending on the season. The island features easy hiking trails and two viewpoints to suit both spectacular sunrise and sunsets. Lawa Darat island is well protected from strong winds and waves, making the island the perfect spot for various activities to be carried out in safety. Some even refer to the island as the Komodo’s fjord, as attributed to its geological position. Besides, Lawa Darat island’s proximity to the ocean crossroads enables visitors to experience unexpected marine surprises such as encountering the humpback or the blue whale emerging majestically from the sea. The main attraction of Lawa Darat island is the scenic view that awaits visitors as they trek and reach the peak. This sole reason is what drives most Komodo National Park visitors to land on this island. Although beautiful all day long, the best recommended time to trek to the peak is sunset, when the breathtaking panoramic view calls for an Instagram selfie. The vantage point makes it perfect for capturing the beautiful beaches or the rolling hills catching rays of light. Trekking to the peak of the island might be considered as quite challenging for some, in particular, the beginners, but it is incredibly doable and worthwhile. The view is better and more beautiful as you trek higher where the reef becomes clearer while the mountainside begins to glow. Be ready for the remarkable panorama that awaits you at the top where the Komodo National Park lies in the opposite.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.title: Horseshoe Bay, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south.
programme.longSynopsis: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area of Rinca island south is undeveloped compared to Komodo island. It is dry and hot, the dense forest will give way to savannah grass. The area is well known to have many Komodo dragons as well as wild pigs, buffalos, deers, monkeys and many bird species.

programme.desc: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean.
programme.title: Dive Site Manta Alley, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean.
programme.longSynopsis: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean. Manta Alley consists of a series of small rocky islands a few hundred meters away from the main island. There are several spots around these rocks where mantas can be found almost all year round. The site starts in a shallow reef close to the shore, where you can expect a strong to mild drift dive. You should keep your eyes wide open just as you enter the water, as mantas can be often found right in the shallows. Manta Rays are coming to this area for mating and cleaning purposes, where small wrasse and butterfly fish clean the mantas of parasites. The cleaning station is around 20 meters, where the rocks meet a white sandy bottom, perfect spot to watch mantas gliding into the rocks. Though mantas are the main attraction of this site, Manta Alley it is also full of marine life including reef sharks, schools of trevallies and large wrasses. The corals are very beautiful and diverse as well, making this spot a spectacular background for marine life photography.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Maravilla, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. The cenote is a sinkhole in the shape of a bell, where the entrance is a hole in the middle of the top. The thick sulfur cloud offers views that look from another planet. Getting close to this cloud is necessary to observe the gorgeous living stalactites, the biothems often called “Hell’s bells.” Those mysterious rock formations are alive and grow underwater thanks to extraordinary endemic bacteria. This type of speleothems, called “elephant feet,” has been found in only 4 cenotes, all in the Puerto Morelos area and are subject to ongoing scientific research.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain.
programme.title: Dive Site Boo West, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain.
programme.longSynopsis: Boo West dive site is located on the most western tip of the Boo island chain. There are rows of sea fans, large and small. The palette of the coral reefs ranges from yellow to pink to purple. A school of silver slides can show off as they moved rapidly as a pack.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Kecil, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park.
programme.longSynopsis: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. The best time to dive this site is when the current is running! This is a real rollercoaster of a ride and will often be referred to as the 'Superman drift'. This gorgeous coral reef with a stunning overhang has a fast moving current - nothing scary just a great drift along. No need to kick! Towards the end of the dive site you drift towards and more sheltered area and the current eases off. Here you can relax (catch your breath!), and admire the stunning hard corals and thousands on anthias. This is also a great spot for seeing hawksbill turtles. The strong currents of this dive site attract large fish including giant trevally, barracuda, tuna, sharks and the odd ray too! The overhangs provide a fascinating topography and if the current allows they are great to explore and hunt for nurse sharks, bamboo sharks and other bizarre creatures.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (northern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.title: Batu Bolong north, Komodo, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Exploration and marine life of Batu Bolong dive site (northern side), Komodo, Indonesia
programme.longSynopsis: You are about to go on a fascinating journey through the amazing underwater world of Batu Bolong. As you watch this remarkable documentary, you will discover the wonderful beauty and diversity of life below the waves. Located within Indonesia's Komodo National Park, Batu Bolong's exposed rock pinnacle reveals a hidden paradise full of marine wonders. Despite challenges like changing currents and depths, you will learn how expert divers navigate the currents and explore different depths, from shallow coral gardens to tall walls. You will see the vibrant underwater dance of reef fish, including colorful groupers, moray eels, and majestic emperor fish. You will encounter the mysterious white tip reef shark, marvel at its unique anatomy, and understand its interesting behaviors. As the documentary reveals the top predator, the giant trevally, you will be captivated by its striking features and hunting skills. You will delve into the complex relationships within the ecosystem, from cleaner fish caring for their companions to the vital role of table corals in sheltering marine life. Immerse yourself in this kaleidoscope of colors, shapes, and behaviors, and let the enchanting beauty of Batu Bolong's underwater world leave you longing for more, ready to return to this aquatic oasis time and again.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Angelita, Tulum, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum. Angelita is a magical cenote that is often described as mysterious and a bit spooky. At first, the cenote appears to be unassuming, just a small pond in the middle of a very thick jungle. However, the deepest parts of the cenote go down to 204 ft (66 m). Its most amazing feature is a 4.5 ft (1.5 m) thick hydrogen sulfide cloud that starts at 83 ft (27 m). This cloud is made up of gases that have leaked out of decomposing trees and leaves that fall from the jungle into the cenote. This gas accumulates where the fresh and the salt water meet (the halocline). This creates a false floor at the bottom, which can be traversed to reach a dark, otherworldly chamber that is full of jungle detritus. The base of this mountain of detritus starts below but reaches above the cloud. Rising again from below the cloud, the peak of the mountain of detritus takes on a new face, as if one is ascending a cloud-topped mountain. On the way out of the cenote, there is a small cave loop, and at the surface, one can get an appreciation for all of the trees that provide this cenote with its hydrogen sulfide cloud.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Tormentos, Cozumel, Mexico (Part 1)
programme.shortSynopsis: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Tormentos dive site is located near Mia beach in the west of Cozumel. Tormentos Reef is located off the coast of Cozumel and houses a rich variety of marine life. Here you can find purple and orange coral structures, tunnels hiding nurse sharks and sea turtles, and huge rays nestled in the sand.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Paradise Reef, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel. Paradise Reef is the first reef when entering the Marine Park. The current runs from south to north normally. You will start across from the entrance to the Caleta and drift north. There are 2-3 coral ridges that parallel the shoreline. You can see schools of Grunts, Snappers, and Sergeant Majors, many Queen Angelfish. There are nice coral heads ranging from 3-6m tall that jut out from a sandy bottom. You can find anemones, and an assortment of nice sponges clinging to the coral heads. Just about every kind of fish from the area can be found here. Some of the bigger animals include barracuda and grouper. Keep a close eye for the small denizens such as Spotted Drum, Smooth Trunkfish, Spotted Moray Eels, and Spiny Lobster.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island.
programme.title: Lawalaut Island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island. Gili Lawa Laut is understandably a magnet for visitors on land and sea. The island is in the Lesser Sunda Islands and sits to the north of Komodo Island and the other small islet of Gili Lawa Daret and as such is protected as part of the Komodo National Park. Geologically the islets are volcanic like much of the region and they have beautiful hills popular with hikers who come for the stunning views and secluded beaches. The island is uninhabited but has numerous trails for walking up the hills to see the surrounding area. The wildlife above water is slightly less of a draw than the sea life on this island as there is less vegetation than in other areas. The hills are grassy though, and the landscape is very beautiful and a popular photography spot for visitors to the national park.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua.
programme.title: Arborek Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua.
programme.longSynopsis: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua. It is easily walkable on foot, taking roughly thirty minutes to walk the entire coastline. The island is known for its very hospitable tourism village and exceptional handicrafts with a thriving souvenir community. Be ready to be greeted with open arms by everyone, with many children who are eager to be photographed. This authentic island welcomes guests with pride, the islanders are happy to introduce all to the Papuan culture and unique traditional foods. It is a perfect paradise to learn a bit of the Asai culture, which is still kept alive in this isolated place. Arborek island, traditionally a mooring spot for boatmen, is surrounded by splendid sago palms, nourished by fish and it is sparsely populated by a tiny population of around 200 residents, spread in around 40 families. The water is crystal clear, with white fine sand and many coconut trees and bushes, providing a quite comforting and refreshing atmosphere. At the wooden pier you will find some gazebos, ideal for relaxing.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Yucab, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel. There is a huge concentration of marine life which covers this reef. There are sponges everywhere and of every color. The sand scoured overhangs offer refuge for lobsters, banded coral shrimps and the arrow crab. There are also large numbers of squirrelfish, angel and butterflyfish always swimming in pairs. This is a great site for photographers.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site Paso Del Cedral, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel. Also called Cedral Wall it is one of the most beautiful dive sites in Cozumel. It can be done as a wall dive or closer to shore over the reef. The part of the reef that is not a wall, consists of a mile of sloping hills covered in sponges and coral. The reef bottoms out at about 18 meters (60 feet). As for the current, it's generally moderate to strong. As you drift you'll get to see eagle rays, lobsters, hawksbill turtles, green morays, big pufferfish, toadfish, and even sharks.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Tank Rock dive site is located on the eastern tip of the Fiabacet Islands.
programme.title: Dive Site Tank Rock, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Tank Rock dive site is located on the eastern tip of the Fiabacet Islands.
programme.longSynopsis: Tank Rock dive site is located on the eastern tip of the Fiabacet Islands. The main feature of Tank Rock is the pinnacles off the east end of the rock, which are covered with colorful invertebrates and schools of fish. The north side of the ridge contains bommies, which are more colorful than those on the south.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Citrus Ridge dive site is located in the channel between Yanggefo and Gam Islands.
programme.title: Dive Site Citrus Ridge, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Citrus Ridge dive site is located in the channel between Yanggefo and Gam Islands.
programme.longSynopsis: Citrus Ridge dive site is located in the channel between Yanggefo and Gam Islands. A reef slope covered with mostly orange and purple soft corals. One of north Raja’s most colorful reefs. Deeper channel (Gam) side of reef usually has good schooling fish action. This reef has it all, reef fish, schooling pelagics, colorful bommies, wobbegong sharks, turtles, macro life. An outstanding dive!
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Cape Kri is a dive site located on the northeast side of Kri Island.
programme.title: Dive Site Cape Kri, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Cape Kri is a dive site located on the northeast side of Kri Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Cape Kri is a dive site located on the northeast side of Kri Island. The site features a reef with a sloping wall. It is known around Raja Ampat area to have widest range of marine life occupying it. There are always huge schools of fish passing by. At the base of the reef, at 38 m/124ft, an ancient snagged anchor can be found.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.title: Playa Del Carmen, Sabalos, Mexico

programme.desc: San Clemente dive site is located in the south west of Cozumel.
programme.title: Dive Site San Clemente, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: San Clemente dive site is located in the south west of Cozumel.
programme.longSynopsis: San Clemente dive site is located in the south west of Cozumel. San Clemente Reef is a beginner diver's dream, with shallow depth between 10 meters and 15 meters and little current. As it is located between the Yucab Reef and the Tormentos Reef, San Clemente shares plenty of similarities with these two dive sites. Divers can encounter here spotted moray eels, butterflyfish swimming in pairs, groupers, snappers, grunts, scorpionfish, angelfish, seahorses hidden in the grass, damselfish, cowfish, eagle rays, filefish, barracudas. This dive spot has a mostly sandy bottom with coral outcrops and patches.

programme.desc: Blue Magic dive site is situated between the island of Kri and the main island of Waisai, in the Dampier Strait.
programme.title: Dive Site Blue Magic, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Blue Magic dive site is situated between the island of Kri and the main island of Waisai, in the Dampier Strait.
programme.longSynopsis: Blue Magic dive site is situated between the island of Kri and the main island of Waisai, in the Dampier Strait. It is a pinnacle reef out in the open ocean with the reef starting at around 8 meters from the surface and descends down to a depth of approximately 30 meters. Almost everything can be seen from mantas, sharks and tuna to massive schools of jacks and barracuda. Along the slopes and onto the reef top are a variety of fans, sponges and soft and hard corals.

programme.desc: Wayil Islands are located northwest of Wayibatan Island.
programme.title: Wayil Islands, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Wayil Islands are located northwest of Wayibatan Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Wayil Islands are located northwest of Wayibatan Island. The wild labyrinth of lagoons among the craggy islets of Wayil in Misool is the definition of tranquillity. Also known as Wayil Batan islands, witness plenty of deserted beaches with spectacular scenery. Wayil Batan islands come from karst that was broken off from larger islands nearby.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Zapote, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. Cenote Zapote is named after the Sapote trees growing nearby. It is located on the “Ruta de los Cenotes” the old road from Puerto Morelos to Valladolid. Zapote has quite a deep drop from the land surface to the water surface of 6m/20ft but its access is easy via stairs. The walls will rise above you like a fortress and once you start your descent they become narrower until a depth of 20m/66ft before starting to open back up again. Once you reach a depth of 30m/100ft you will be above the talus cone in a bell shaped chamber with a narrow skylight in the top through which you just descended. Halocline and a thin misty layer of Hydrogen Sulfide floating on top of it, as well as some of the most amazing and incredible formations commonly described as bells, elephant feet, shower heads or trumpets will truly take your breath away with their strange beauty and impressive size.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai.
programme.title: Dive Site Saporkren at Night, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai.
programme.longSynopsis: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai. This site is typically dived at night, however day diving is good too. Saporkren is your typical sandy bottom muck dive site, which is a little grubby since its just off of the village jetty. Making your way down a gentle slope (with little or no current) past a few coral bommies, the best bit of Saporkren is generally around 12-20 metres. We found full-size seahorses, cute bobtail squid, flying flatworms, clownfish anemones, colemani shrimp plus many unusual crabs species such as the boxer, xeno and porcelain.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island.
programme.title: Padar island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.shortSynopsis: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island.
programme.longSynopsis: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island. Padar is the third largest island in the Komodo National Park. It is located in the south central of the park, between Komodo and Rinca Island. In the past, Padar was one of the island in Komodo where there were dragons live. Along with the illegal hunting activities by human being, they are slowly disappeared and almost unable to see them anymore. The cause is simply because of the lack of foods, like deer and wild boar. Their extinction can be because they just died alone without any food to eat or prolonged hunger or they can be migrated to nearest island, Rinca. The island now remains empty with no dragons. However, other wild animals such as wild boars are still around daily. Today, Padar has become one of the most popular place to visit in Indonesia. It offers super magnificent view from the top of the island with pink sandy beach on the west side and white sandy beach on the east side. Formation of towering hill, just like Jurassic park. Although the island has no dragons existed, the island is one of the best charming spot of trekking. Those who love photographic, this is perhaps the best place for spectacular photos.
programme.tags: Drone View, Landscape

programme.desc: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos.
programme.title: Dive Site C56 Shipwreck, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.shortSynopsis: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos.
programme.longSynopsis: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos. The C-56 shipwreck served in World War II and it was sold to the Mexican Marine in 1966. The time pass by and later on 28th Oct 2000 was purposefully sunk, as a new attraction for divers coming to the Riviera Maya. Laying perfectly upright, with the keel on the sand at 90ft, the 184ft long Mexican Gun Boat was quickly inhabited by various marine life. The deck, at 64ft, is teeming with life and it's common to see a large shoal of Big Eye Travellies hunting there. As we travel around the wreck we commonly see large Wrasse, Groupers, Morays and, looking up, flights of Eagle Rays. Soft corals have colonized the wreck and now offer a home to many Arrow crabs and Fire worms amongst other small crustaceans and invertebrates.
programme.tags: Diving, Dive Site

programme.desc: Join Kale Krew as they explore Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall and some of the best vegan food!
programme.title: Kale Krew - Plant X Market
programme.shortSynopsis: Join Kale Krew as they explore Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall and some of the best vegan food!
programme.longSynopsis: In this must-see episode, Nemanja and Tamika kick things off with a tour of Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall. Home to six extraordinary vegan restaurants, XMarket features Kale My Name, 2D Restaurant, El Hongo Magico, Chicago Not Dog, Veganiano, and Bloom Sushi Counter. Plus, it boasts a full-service bar and a plant-based supermarket! Whether you're a seasoned vegan or just curious, you’ll be amazed by the creativity and flavor bursting from every corner of this vibrant food hall.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Visit a cool vegan ice cream shop on Chicago's South Side with a delicious backstory.
programme.title: Kale Krew - Runaway Cow Ice Cream
programme.shortSynopsis: Visit a cool vegan ice cream shop on Chicago's South Side with a delicious backstory.
programme.longSynopsis: Runaway Cow is a unique, vegan ice cream shop in Bridgeport, on Chicago's South Side, near famed Comiskey Park baseball stadium. Their banana split is to die for. Then, again, so is their soft serve. The mouthwatering list of menu items goes on. This is a MUST stop on any visit to the Windy City. And, the backstory is equally compelling. Alison Eichhorn and Aaron Guttierez are Runaway Cow's owners and life partners.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: There's only one Kat Von D and she is making the scene at Farm Sanctuary!
programme.title: Highway to Health - Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary
programme.shortSynopsis: There's only one Kat Von D and she is making the scene at Farm Sanctuary!
programme.longSynopsis: International touring musicians, our hosts Derrick Green and Tanya O'Callaghan, meet up with Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary, just 45 minutes outside Los Angeles. Almost immediately Tanya is so warmly greeted by a sheep that she is knocked on her arse. It gets better from there… a lot better. Farm Sanctuary is an iconic refuge for cows, pigs, chickens, turkeys, goats and sheep who have escaped or been rescued from the horrors of industrialized animal agriculture, aka factory farming.
programme.tags: Activism
programme.episodeTitle: Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary

programme.desc: Vancouver has a happening vegan scene. Delish food and - in the summer - this island is paradise!
programme.title: The Vegan Roadie - Oh Canada... Yum!
programme.shortSynopsis: Vancouver has a happening vegan scene. Delish food and - in the summer - this island is paradise!
programme.longSynopsis: Did you know that Vancouver is the largest island on the west coast of North America? And, even though it's massive, it keeps that island feel, especially in the summer. Located in the Canadian province of British Columbia, Vancouver is a gem for travelers who want a unique, yet sophisticated, experience. The best part is the hopping food scene with tons of vegan restaurants and eateries with plenty of vegan options.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Two amazing capital cities in one fabulous vegan video! Wow!
programme.title: Vegan Travel with Eunice Reyes - Seoul, South Korea & Tokyo, Japan
programme.shortSynopsis: Two amazing capital cities in one fabulous vegan video! Wow!
programme.longSynopsis: When you think of Korean cuisine, kimchi might come to mind. Vegan kimchi (no fish sauce or anchovy) is all the rage in Seoul. When you think of Japanese cuisine, sushi is likely your first thought. There is astounding vegan sushi in Tokyo. But, there's so much more to try. Hop on a virtual flight to these two extraordinary capital cities and follow Rate V for Vegan's Eunice Reyes as she gives us a whirlwind tour!
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Take a tour of Singapore and discover delicious plant-based cuisine! It's a trip!
programme.title: Vegan Travel with Eunice Reyes - Singapore's Fabulous Vegan Scene!
programme.shortSynopsis: Take a tour of Singapore and discover delicious plant-based cuisine! It's a trip!
programme.longSynopsis: Singapore is a visual and taste sensation. Rated V for Vegan's Eunice Reyes gives us a fabulous tour! From vegan jumbo shrimp to dumplings and beyond, this former British colony turned island-nation knows how to live. Singapore has been an independent republic since 1965 and has FOUR official languages, Chinese, Malay, Tamil and English. So, it's pretty easy for English speakers, like Eunice Reyes, to get around.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: 5 delicious pizza pies, all 100% plant-based. Skip the dairy, chuck the cholesterol and enjoy pizza!
programme.title: Vegan Travel with Eunice Reyes - Pizza, Pizza, Pizza, Pizza, Pizza
programme.shortSynopsis: 5 delicious pizza pies, all 100% plant-based. Skip the dairy, chuck the cholesterol and enjoy pizza!
programme.longSynopsis: Rated V for Vegan travel queen Eunice Reyes tackles the Mount Everest of plant-based challenges: cheese, as in cheese pizza. So many people say they could never give up cheese, thinking it would mean they could never enjoy pizza. Guess what? There are mouthwatering vegan pizzas out there. Eunice found 5 different offerings in Los Angeles alone! From Venice Beach to the LA outskirts, Eunice devoured 5 pies.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.shortSynopsis: LMFAO's Redfoo & his partner Jazzy are sexy and they know it. And, they love animals & vegan life!

programme.longSynopsis: Get the inside story of how Chicago's vegan restaurant, Can't Believe It's Not Meat, came to be and watch the owner, Chef Fab, reveal the secrets to turning America's favorite meat dishes into delicious plant-based creations. Laricia Chandler Baker, known as Chef Fab, is an American entrepreneur, businesswoman, and chef.

programme.longSynopsis: In this must-see episode, Nemanja and Tamika kick things off with a tour of Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall. Whether you're a seasoned vegan or just curious, you’ll be amazed by the creativity and flavor bursting from every corner of this vibrant food hall.

programme.desc: The Vegan Roadie takes the ancient road to Rome and savors some fabulous plant-based dishes!
programme.title: The Vegan Roadie - A Roman Culinary Adventure!
programme.shortSynopsis: The Vegan Roadie takes the ancient road to Rome and savors some fabulous plant-based dishes!
programme.longSynopsis: Italian food, like many cuisines that stem from the Mediterranean, is naturally plant-based. Let's visit some of Italy's top plant-based restaurants, where mushrooms, greens, nuts and so much more are combined for optimal flavor. Did you know that all vegan foods have zero cholesterol? Now, time for our date with Dustin Harder, the Vegan Roadie! When in Rome.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: So many delicious foods from Minneapolis. Try the vegan meats that make Minneapolis a vegan hotspot!
programme.title: The Vegan Roadie - Mouthwatering Eats in Minneapolis
programme.shortSynopsis: So many delicious foods from Minneapolis. Try the vegan meats that make Minneapolis a vegan hotspot!
programme.longSynopsis: Minneapolis is known for star performers from Prince to Nirvana but the Vegan Roadie is on a mission to show that this city should be on everyone's travel plans with loads of tantalizing vegan options! The Reverie has something for everybody with a coffee bar, cocktail bar and an all-day cafe housing live events as well! Feast your sights on their BBQ Berbere, Cubano and TLT. Modern Times cafe serves up vegan brunch and breakfast items with ease and some of the tastiest sandwiches ever!
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Vancouver has a happening vegan scene. Delish food and - in the summer - this island is paradise!
programme.title: The Vegan Roadie - Oh Canada... Yum!
programme.shortSynopsis: Vancouver has a happening vegan scene. Delish food and - in the summer - this island is paradise!
programme.longSynopsis: Did you know that Vancouver is the largest island on the west coast of North America? And, even though it's massive, it keeps that island feel, especially in the summer. Located in the Canadian province of British Columbia, Vancouver is a gem for travelers who want a unique, yet sophisticated, experience. The best part is the hopping food scene with tons of vegan restaurants and eateries with plenty of vegan options.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Chef Mario Fabbri launched one of the world's first vegan cooking shows on TV. Now, he reveals all!
programme.title: Trying Vegan With Mario - Chef Mario Reveals Cooking Secrets
programme.shortSynopsis: Chef Mario Fabbri launched one of the world's first vegan cooking shows on TV. Now, he reveals all!
programme.longSynopsis: Mario Fabbri, host of Trying Vegan with Mario, is captivating audiences with his 22-episode vegan cooking series on UnchainedTV. Joined by top vegan chefs and doctors like Lauren Toyota and Dr. Joel Fuhrman, Mario creates nutrient-packed, indulgent dishes—from Italian classics to desserts. With 60K IG followers @marioFabbriChef, Mario’s mission is a win for you, the planet, and animals. Watch now on UnchainedTV!
programme.tags: Healthy Cooking and Eating

programme.desc: There's only one Kat Von D and she is making the scene at Farm Sanctuary!
programme.title: Highway to Health - Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary
programme.shortSynopsis: There's only one Kat Von D and she is making the scene at Farm Sanctuary!
programme.longSynopsis: International touring musicians, our hosts Derrick Green and Tanya O'Callaghan, meet up with Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary, just 45 minutes outside Los Angeles. Almost immediately Tanya is so warmly greeted by a sheep that she is knocked on her arse. It gets better from there… a lot better. Farm Sanctuary is an iconic refuge for cows, pigs, chickens, turkeys, goats and sheep who have escaped or been rescued from the horrors of industrialized animal agriculture, aka factory farming.
programme.tags: Activism
programme.episodeTitle: Kat Von D at Farm Sanctuary

programme.desc: After a fruit-filled breakfast, rockers Derrick Green and Tanya O'Callaghan meet up with Fabio
programme.title: Highway to Health - Touring Brazil
programme.shortSynopsis: After a fruit-filled breakfast, rockers Derrick Green and Tanya O'Callaghan meet up with Fabio
programme.longSynopsis: This season starts in Brazil, where Derrick Green moved to when he joined a famous Brazilian band. After touring the vast Sao Paulo food courts and sampling some astounding pasteles, Green and his co-host Tanya O'Callaghan end up in West Hollywood, where they hang out with famed actor/director Kevin Smith, who reveals how he almost died before turning his life around.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Famed actor/director Kevin Smith reveals how he went vegan after almost dying of a heart attack.
programme.title: Highway to Health - Kevin Smith at Crossroads LA
programme.shortSynopsis: Famed actor/director Kevin Smith reveals how he went vegan after almost dying of a heart attack.
programme.longSynopsis: Kevin Smith, a multi-talented screenwriter, actor, director and comic book writer who rose to fame with the 1994 film Clerks, which was followed by Mallrats, Chasing Amy, Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back, Clerks II, Clerks III and more. Kevin meets Tanya and Derrick for a meal at Crossroads Kitchen in West Hollywood, where Kevin reveals how he almost died of heart disease and how his vegan daughter, actress/musician Harley Quinn Smith, convinced him to try going vegan for his health.
programme.tags: Pop Culture

programme.desc: These rockers hit the road to Rio and pick up some incredible talent along the way.
programme.title: Highway to Health - Rio Revealed: Paulo Jr. and Cléo Pires Shine at Teva’s Vegan Hotspot
programme.shortSynopsis: These rockers hit the road to Rio and pick up some incredible talent along the way.
programme.longSynopsis: We finally arrive in Rio de Janeiro, where the Christ statue looks over Rio's famous Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. Along for the ride is Paulo, Jr. of the famous Brazilian band Sepultura. Bandmate Derrick Green and his co-host Tanya O'Callaghan take us to Teva, a high-end vegetable bar. There they meet up with famed Brazilian actress and singer Cléo Pires, who is known mostly as just Cléo! Check out those nails! Wow! One of her hits is Jungle Kid. She tells them her story.
programme.tags: Dining Out
programme.episodeTitle: Rio Revealed: Paulo Jr. and Cléo Pires Shine at Teva’s Vegan Hotspot

programme.desc: This is the sexiest protest you will ever see!

programme.desc: Join stars on the red carpet for animal rights at the 2023 Last Chance for Animals gala!
programme.title: Last Chance for Animals Wows Hollywood
programme.shortSynopsis: Join stars on the red carpet for animal rights at the 2023 Last Chance for Animals gala!
programme.longSynopsis: Take a virtual stroll down the red carpet at the 2023 Last Chance for Animals gala! Join UnchainedTV as celebrities like Diane Warren, Catherine Hardwicke, Joanna Krupa, and more rally for animal rights. Listen to Chris DeRose, LCA’s founder, share the organization's latest victories, saving countless animals from laboratory suffering. This star-studded event celebrates compassion and the powerful impact of animal advocacy. Watch now and get inspired to take action!

programme.desc: He hides his face. He often works at night. He goes into his discomfort zone daily for the truth!
programme.title: Rob Banks - The Edgy Activist
programme.shortSynopsis: He hides his face. He often works at night. He goes into his discomfort zone daily for the truth!
programme.longSynopsis: Rob Banks wants to get the truth out there & goes to extreme lengths so you see it on the street! Working from behind a bandana that covers his face, using the whole city of Los Angeles as his canvas, this animal activist extraordinaire is captivating and controversial. In this short film, he teams up with another vegan artist. They take the streets for one reason: to wake you up. Directed by Jordan Erlich.
programme.tags: Activism

programme.desc: Beans & Beginnings - Think tofu is boring? Think again.
programme.title: At Home with The Jenners - Beans & Beginnings
programme.shortSynopsis: Beans & Beginnings - Think tofu is boring? Think again.
programme.longSynopsis: Watch Cayley guide Brandon through his first tofu adventure as they create a protein-packed scramble that'll convert any skeptic. With turmeric-kissed beans and fresh herbs straight from their garden, this power couple proves that plant-based protein can be a crave-worthy masterpiece.
programme.tags: Vegan Diets

programme.desc: A garden-fresh tomato tart that'll make you forget it's vegan!
programme.title: At Home with the Jenners: Tomatoes & (rescued) Chickens
programme.shortSynopsis: A garden-fresh tomato tart that'll make you forget it's vegan!
programme.longSynopsis: A garden-fresh tomato tart that'll make you forget it's vegan! Join Cayley and Brandon (plus their scene-stealing flock of rescued chickens) as they create pure summer magic with puff pastry, caramelized onions, and tomatoes still warm from the vine. Warning: This episode may cause serious kitchen envy.
programme.tags: Vegan Diets

programme.desc: Nemanja & Tamika hit Can't Believe It's Not Meat restaurant in Chicago for some delish comfort food.
programme.title: Kale Krew - Can't Believe It's Not Meat
programme.shortSynopsis: Nemanja & Tamika hit Can't Believe It's Not Meat restaurant in Chicago for some delish comfort food.
programme.longSynopsis: Get the inside story of how Chicago's vegan restaurant, Can't Believe It's Not Meat, came to be and watch the owner, Chef Fab, reveal the secrets to turning America's favorite meat dishes into delicious plant-based creations. From her famous Patty Melt to Philly Cheese Steak Egg Rolls to Barrios Tacos and beyond, Chef Fab transforms comfort food favorites into vegan masterpieces. Laricia Chandler Baker, known as Chef Fab, is an American entrepreneur, businesswoman, and chef.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Kale Krew stars visit Spirit Elephant, a gourmet vegan restaurant in Winnetka, IL, near Chicago.
programme.title: Kale Krew - Spirit Elephant
programme.shortSynopsis: Kale Krew stars visit Spirit Elephant, a gourmet vegan restaurant in Winnetka, IL, near Chicago.
programme.longSynopsis: Nemanja and Tamika, flip over Spirit Elephant, just outside of Chicago, as they get to sample the restaurant's sumptuous summer menu. The dishes are almost too gorgeous to eat… almost. The only thing that surpasses their beauty is their taste! This vegan restaurant is stylishly decorated with a sophisticated look that screams date night and a menu that makes you want to try everything on it.. which Nemanja and Tamika pretty much did after chatting with owner CD Young.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Join Kale Krew as they explore Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall and some of the best vegan food!
programme.title: Kale Krew - Plant X Market
programme.shortSynopsis: Join Kale Krew as they explore Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall and some of the best vegan food!
programme.longSynopsis: In this must-see episode, Nemanja and Tamika kick things off with a tour of Chicago's famed XMarket Food Hall. Home to six extraordinary vegan restaurants, XMarket features Kale My Name, 2D Restaurant, El Hongo Magico, Chicago Not Dog, Veganiano, and Bloom Sushi Counter. Plus, it boasts a full-service bar and a plant-based supermarket! Whether you're a seasoned vegan or just curious, you’ll be amazed by the creativity and flavor bursting from every corner of this vibrant food hall.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.desc: Visit a cool vegan ice cream shop on Chicago's South Side with a delicious backstory.
programme.title: Kale Krew - Runaway Cow Ice Cream
programme.shortSynopsis: Visit a cool vegan ice cream shop on Chicago's South Side with a delicious backstory.
programme.longSynopsis: Runaway Cow is a unique, vegan ice cream shop in Bridgeport, on Chicago's South Side, near famed Comiskey Park baseball stadium. Their banana split is to die for. Then, again, so is their soft serve. The mouthwatering list of menu items goes on. This is a MUST stop on any visit to the Windy City. And, the backstory is equally compelling. Alison Eichhorn and Aaron Guttierez are Runaway Cow's owners and life partners.
programme.tags: Dining Out

programme.longSynopsis: Jack of All Tastes is hosted by Jackie Long and powered by famous athletes and unique eateries. Follow Jackie as he journeys from city to city and dines with NFL athletes and their significant others. Each NFL star introduces Jackie to their go-to dish at their favorite restaurant in the town, where they play while sharing their personal stories. After diving in, Jackie heads to the kitchen to learn the secrets behind the magic. The head chef gives her inside information on the restaurant, what makes it special, and the cooking methods used in the signature dishes. With the players' helmets off, Jackie gives viewers the rare opportunity to hang out and get to know a different side of them at their favorite eateries on their day off.
